request: Analyze GSE283691 for PMID 41027539 (Dietary and exercise interventions improve cognition and alter hippocampal transcriptomics in a mouse model of the metabolic syndrome.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, male C57BL/6J mouse hippocampus, terminal (26 weeks of age)
final.inclusion: All 7 groups sequenced; GEO has 7 mice per group (6 for KDI_EX), a subset of the 15-16 per group phenotyped (S2.1.p1).
final.primary_estimand: Effect of an 8-week voluntary wheel-running intervention (EXI, kept on HFD) on the hippocampal transcriptome of HFD-induced MetS mice, versus continued sedentary HFD. Secondary: combined KD + exercise intervention (KDI-EXI) versus HFD.
planned_contrasts: HFD vs SD, KD vs HFD, KD vs SD, SDI vs HFD, KDI vs HFD (S3.4.p2; non-exercise diet contrasts: 236, 240, 138, 174, 206 DEGs)
EXI vs SD, KDI-EXI vs SD (S3.5.p3; pathways only, DEG counts only in Supplementary Table S1, not available)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one hippocampus per independent singly-housed mouse
final.normalization: STAR + RSEM count estimates; DESeq2 (S2.7.1.p1, S2.7.2.p1)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 in R, pairwise group comparisons (S2.7.2.p1)
final.paper_results: EXI vs HFD 397 DEGs, KDI-EXI vs HFD 721 DEGs, 147 shared; Rpl7a-ps11 up in EXI and KDI-EXI vs HFD; Lep, Ces1d, Ifi27l2a, Hp down after EXI vs HFD (S3.4.p2)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.1.p1 defines the preventative (SD/HFD/KD) and intervention (HFD/SDI/KDI/EXI/KDI-EXI) arms. The only exercise-only contrast is EXI vs HFD (both on HFD; EXI adds a running wheel from week 18). KDI-EXI vs HFD confounds the diet switch with exercise. S2.7.2.p1: DESeq2, unadjusted p < 0.01, no fold-change rule. S3.4.p2 gives the DEG counts.
